With the weather being so nice and sunny lately, I decided it was time to pull out my poor neglected road bike, do a little bit of wrench turning, clean and re-lube the chain, and put him back into regular use again. I have to say that going back to skinny tires again feels refreshing! I didn't realize how much I'd missed it.

I had a ton of flats last summer. Some weeks I was getting 2 or 3. This year I'm going to run self-sealing tubes. I have never run them with a skinny high pressure presta road tube and tire before, so I don't know how effective they'll be, but I guess I'll find out. They've never once let me down when it comes to wide lower pressure schraders.

I have read claims that self-sealers won't work at higher pressures. Then again, I have also read other claims that they don't work at all, that they somehow ruin pumps, that they spurt out of valves, etc. These other claims seem to come from idiots who don't understand that large holes can't be self-sealed, and that inflating self-sealing tubes requires an easy precaution they'd know about if they just read the instructions. So, is there any truth at all to the "ineffective at high pressure" claim? It seems to me that they wouldn't be making these things for road tires if they didn't work.

Does anybody have any experience with them?

Aeon was enraged.

He had always been enraged, the perversion of existence disgusted him. The despicable things sentients would do to one another infuriated him. Anything less than the void was imperfect, abhorrent, impure.

He could change that, slowly, but surely, he could change that. The Void had all the time in the world, it had all the world in the world, it was everything, it was nothing, there was no difference.

He visited the Null Space, the abomination that dared to combine the void and "existence" and cursed its very existence, Then he entered the Nexus.

One by one, the Universes blinked out, under his guiding hand. Bit by bit, the entire Multiverse began to shrink, until it was just one universe, just one world.

This one particular world had a seal on it. Four such seals, to keep him out. Four guarded seals, strengthened by their guardians, made secure against HIM. Surely it was the work of his sentimental, flighty sister.

Yet it was imperfect, there was a flaw, a seal left weakened by the absence of a guardian, for what seemed like a short period in time. Seeing opportunity, he struck, and weakened the one seal further.

Inside the empty world, inside the seal, there was sentience. Sentience suffering inevitably, as they are prone to do. Sentience reacting in anger and frustration at the cruel uncaring world, that drops hunters upon them and destroy their homes.

In their minds, he left a message.

**Everything ends, Know this, accept it, own it. If all must fall, may it be at your hands.**

An idea, that does what many ideas tend to do. It spreads, occasionally taking root. Eventually, some would go mad, worshiping a mad god. Aeon the Destroyer, Eye of the Void and Silence and Grief. They invited him into their minds, and such an invitation would always be accepted.

After the seeds of corruption had been sowed, Aeon returned to the Void. Even being in proximity to the other universes was utterly disgusting.

Then, a message interrupted his thoughts, a single voice, [asking about the fulfillment of a burden](/v/SavageReSurgence/comments/956343)

[And he would give his answer.](https://voat.co/v/SavageReSurgence/comments/956343/4795016)
Through weakened seals Aeon goes out and destroys universes, discovers Solus and leaves behind a message for those within before returning to the void.
